name: pack-layout-aware-guard
title: Ship a layout-aware review guard so consumers stop reimplementing one
description: Ship one pack-owned, layout-aware review guard so consumers can delete their bespoke reimplementations instead of porting them. Five consumers each wrote their own pack-layout guard; the fleet's thin-conversion blockers were re-measured at 456, of which 355 are reachable by this guard's two queries (design D6); the original filing's 330-of-510 was computed against a total that no longer exists.
creator: sdelmas
